baseline_models.focus_anchor: The conditional إذا, the arrival verb جاء, and the coordinated nouns نصر الله and الفتح make the ayah an event threshold.
baseline_models.mechanism: Aid becomes present, then a formerly closed state is rendered open. The coordination keeps enabling support and opened outcome distinguishable rather than reducing both nouns to one generic victory label.

activation_trace.role: Coming and arrival supply the threshold at which aid becomes present rather than remaining a static possession.
Aid that makes someone prevail supplies the enabling force of the event.
The fixed divine name identifies the aid's source and prevents an unnamed human actor from absorbing that role.
Opening a closure and widening an aperture supply the changed state paired with the arriving aid.

changed_reading.before: A compact promise that divine victory will happen.
changed_reading.after: A threshold mechanism in which enabling aid becomes present and a blocked field becomes traversably open.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: نصر can image redress after oppression while الفتح can image judgment that settles a closed dispute.
baseline_models.mechanism: The paired nouns can describe a juridical event: divine redress arrives and an unresolved conflict is decisively opened by adjudication. This coexists with, rather than cancels, the military-prevailing reading.

activation_trace.role: Arrival supplies the moment at which a previously pending settlement takes effect.
Redress after oppression recasts aid as the restoration of a wronged party.
The fixed divine name locates the authority of the redress beyond the disputants.
Judgment that resolves a closed dispute supplies the decisive settlement paired with redress.

changed_reading.before: Victory is chiefly the defeat of an opposing force.
changed_reading.after: Victory can also be a divinely authorized redress that closes oppression by settling what had remained judicially locked.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The cluster جاء، نصر، الفتح permits brought good to culminate in relief, disclosure, or guidance.
baseline_models.mechanism: Aid is not only force against an opponent; it can arrive as a presented gift whose effect is to remove an inward obstruction and disclose a way forward.

activation_trace.role: Bringing or presenting something lets the arrival be heard as the presentation of an effective good.
Granting a gift supplies the beneficent substance of the arriving aid.
Worship and the worshipped one keep the gift relationally directed toward devotion rather than mere advantage.
Relief, insight, and disclosure supply the inward effect of the granted aid.

changed_reading.before: Aid arrives as external power and conquest.
changed_reading.after: Aid may arrive as a divine gift that relieves an inward closure and makes knowledge, guidance, or possibility accessible.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: All three event roots carry a coherent water constellation: gathering, rain-relief or tributary flow, and release through an opening.
baseline_models.mechanism: As a material analogy, distant channels bring relieving rain into a gathering place and an opened outlet releases it. The coherence across جاء، نصر، and فتح makes this more than a free-standing water theme, though it remains branch-distant from the surface construction.

activation_trace.role: A hollow where water gathers supplies the receiving basin of the material mechanism.
Rain that relieves and makes land grow supplies aid as life-giving water.
Tributary channels arriving from afar supply the conveyance that gathers relief at the threshold.
Water released from an outlet supplies the transition from gathered potential to distributed effect.

changed_reading.before: The ayah names an abstract or military victory.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, divine aid behaves like relieving water: it arrives through tributaries, gathers, and becomes effective when an outlet is opened.

context_deltas.mechanism: The threshold in 110:1 acquires a public diagnostic in 110:2: it is seen and sensed through human cohorts, so the opening is socially legible rather than an invisible transfer of power.

activation_trace.role: Arrival supplies the event whose occurrence needs a perceptible marker.
A widened opening supplies the changed condition that can become visible in what passes through it.
Seeing by eye or insight supplies direct recognition of the event's manifested effect.
Sensing or detecting a thing makes the human presence function as evidence rather than background population.
Groups of people supply repeated, collective units through which the opening becomes publicly legible.

structural_cues: The second-person observation in 110:2 follows the conditional event of 110:1.
A singular witness is set before plural human movement in cohorts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies arrival, sight or detection, and grouped humans; I infer that the latter are evidence that the 110:1 threshold has occurred. A live alternative is that they are merely consequences after an independently complete victory.

changed_reading.before: The arrival of aid is a divine event whose occurrence could remain privately known.
changed_reading.after: Its arrival becomes recognizable by a public social change: cohorts of humans visibly traverse the newly opened field.

context_deltas.mechanism: The conquest-like opening is revised into permeability: estranged humans can cross an enlarged threshold into a domain of obedience. Success is measured by access and participation, not by keeping an enemy outside.

activation_trace.role: Prevailing aid supplies the power that removes the prior barrier.
A widened aperture supplies the permeable boundary through which the social result occurs.
Sociability that removes estrangement recasts the people as a relation newly made possible by the opening.
Literal entry into an interior supplies the crossing action.
Obedience and willing compliance supply the domain entered rather than a territory merely occupied.
The broad gap reinforces the opening as an aperture enlarged enough for collective passage.

structural_cues: The construction يدخلون في presents religion as an interior or field crossed into.
The plural imperfect and أفواجا make passage distributed across groups rather than a single ceremonial crossing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a widened aperture, entry, removed estrangement, and obedience; I infer that the victory works by enabling communal access. An alternative is externally compelled submission without transformed social relation.

changed_reading.before: Opening means conquest of a closed enemy space.
changed_reading.after: Opening means a boundary becoming permeable enough for formerly estranged people to enter a shared practice of obedience in groups.

context_deltas.mechanism: Visible entry has two live depths. It can be an inner opening into entrusted commitment, but the same publicly seen movement can stop at display; the success of 110:1 therefore cannot be exhausted by counting visible entrants.

activation_trace.role: Inner opening by guidance or disclosure supplies the possible depth beneath outward passage.
Showing oneself before people supplies the live possibility that a visible entry is performative.
The inward or secret dimension supplies a depth not settled by exterior observation.
Hidden corruption supplies a contrary interior state that may coexist with successful outward entry.
Assent and entrustment supply the positive inward realization of entry.

structural_cues: 110:2 juxtaposes what the addressee sees with an action directed into a named interior.
The verse reports collective motion but does not separately state each entrant's inward condition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies public display, inner secrecy, hidden corruption, and entrustment; I infer two coexisting depths of the same entry. Alternatively, the odd display and corruption branches may be irrelevant shadows and the line may describe unqualified entry.

changed_reading.before: The visible mass entry straightforwardly completes the meaning of victory.
changed_reading.after: The opening permits both outward passage and possible inward assent, while leaving a diagnostic gap in which display or hidden corruption can coexist with the visible success.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated divine name links source and destination: aid is of Allah, and the entered obedience is of Allah. Victory is thus a circuit returning bestowed capacity toward worship, not an asset transferred into human ownership.

activation_trace.role: Aid as a granted good supplies what moves from source toward social effect.
The worshipped one supplies the divine source to whom the aid already belongs.
Obedience supplies the relational mode into which the social movement enters.
The repeated worshipped one supplies the destination of that obedience and closes the circuit.

structural_cues: الله appears in a genitive relation to both نصر in 110:1 and دين in 110:2.
The same named referent brackets the transition from arriving aid to human entry.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated divine name as source-marker and destination-marker; I infer a directed circuit from gift to worship. Alternatively, the repetition may mark possession in two independent phrases without a functional return.

changed_reading.before: Divine aid becomes a victory possessed by its human beneficiaries.
changed_reading.after: What comes from Allah remains oriented back toward Allah as people enter divine obedience; the event resists appropriation as human capital.

context_deltas.mechanism: The baseline juridical settlement becomes an inhabitable order. Redress and judgment do not merely end a dispute; cohorts enter a city-like domain of obedience and reckoning, turning verdict into durable social form.

activation_trace.role: Redress after oppression supplies the justice claim behind the new order.
Adjudication supplies the decisive settlement from which an accountable order can begin.
Entry into an interior makes the settled order something people inhabit.
Accounting and recompense supply the order's answerability rather than mere allegiance.
The city of obedience supplies a civic-spatial image for the domain entered.
Human cohorts supply the population by which the verdict becomes social order.

structural_cues: The result of 110:1 is followed by repeated plural entry rather than a description of a defeated opponent.
The container construction في دين allows a spatial-social model without requiring دين itself to be a literal city.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies redress, judgment, entry, accounting, and a city-of-obedience image; I infer that the verdict is institutionalized as an inhabitable order. Alternatively, city and accounting may remain separate lexical branches with no civic mechanism here.

changed_reading.before: Divine judgment ends an oppressive dispute.
changed_reading.after: The settlement opens an accountable order that groups can enter and inhabit, so justice becomes a social arrangement rather than a terminating verdict.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening is not the end-state but the beginning that opens what follows: worship, a praiseworthy aim, nurture, completion, and growth. The conqueror's task changes from obtaining the event to being formed after it.

activation_trace.role: An opening beginning that unlocks what follows makes victory the first phase rather than the finish.
Worship through glorification and prayer supplies the first discipline opened by the event.
The praiseworthy end supplies a telos beyond simply obtaining victory.
Nurture, repair, and completion supply the formative work required after opening.
The non-dominant split image of nourishment and growth extends completion into an exploratory organic process.

structural_cues: The فـ at the start of 110:3 links imperatives to the achieved condition in the preceding ayat.
The sequence moves from public influx to second-person worship and self-correction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an opening-beginning, consequent worship, a praiseworthy end, nurture, and growth; I infer that victory inaugurates formation. A live alternative is that 110:3 prescribes gratitude after a fully complete event without redefining the opening.

changed_reading.before: The opening is the terminal achievement for which one later gives thanks.
changed_reading.after: The opening begins a post-victory formation in which worship, repair, maturation, and a praiseworthy end still have to unfold.

context_deltas.mechanism: A publicly visible opening carries a semantic shadow of display and self-credit. Glorification, praise, and seeking protective forgiveness function as a guard against converting divine aid into the victor's boast.

activation_trace.role: The worshipped one fixes the proper object of devotion and attribution.
Boastful display of wealth or learning supplies the dangerous shadow carried by an achieved opening.
Showing oneself before people makes public visibility the setting in which self-display can arise.
Declaring transcendence and clearing from fault redirects the event away from human self-magnification.
Claiming praise by conferring a favor names the precise appropriation risk that praise of the Lord reverses.
Covering a fault and protecting its bearer from its effect supplies remediation for the victor's attributional failure.

structural_cues: Public seeing and mass movement are followed immediately by commands centered on the Lord rather than the human witness.
Praise and seeking forgiveness are coordinated in the response to success.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies public display, a boast branch of opening, praise-claiming, transcendence, and forgiveness; I infer an ego hazard generated by success and a ritual guard against it. Alternatively, the commands may be generic devotion with no implied boast risk.

changed_reading.before: The opening authorizes uncomplicated celebration by the victorious party.
changed_reading.after: The opening is also an attributional test: its visibility can feed self-display, so its proper completion requires praise redirected to the Lord and protection from self-credit.

context_deltas.mechanism: فتح and غفر create a controlled-boundary paradox. The aperture must open for entry, yet opening also permits hidden corruption or an alien element to mingle; protective covering is therefore part of governing, not undoing, permeability.

activation_trace.role: A widened aperture supplies the necessary but potentially vulnerable boundary condition.
Hidden corruption supplies a possible adverse interior effect of successful entry.
An outsider who mingles with a group supplies the permeability risk without negating genuine entrants.
Covering that preserves and protects supplies the counter-operation that makes openness governable.

structural_cues: Entry through the opened field precedes the command to seek covering and protection.
The sequence preserves both openness and a subsequent protective act rather than choosing one boundary state.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies aperture, entry, hidden interior damage, mingling, and protective covering; I infer that opening creates a need for governed protection. Alternatively, غفر may concern only moral fault and have no boundary-management role.

changed_reading.before: Success is maximal, unqualified openness after a barrier falls.
changed_reading.after: Success is selective permeability: the boundary opens for entry but must also be protected against harms that openness can carry inward.

context_deltas.mechanism: The punctual coming of 110:1 is nested within continuity in 110:3. The opening starts what follows, while enduring lordship and the solicitation of return prevent the event from closing history into a completed triumph.

activation_trace.role: Arrival supplies the bounded event that occurs at a threshold in time.
An opening beginning supplies the event's forward-facing rather than terminal aspect.
Abiding, residence, and continuance supply durable lordship around the punctual event.
Occurrence and presence in time make the closing description explicitly temporal.
Calling another to repent supplies an ongoing invitation to return after the opening.

structural_cues: The threshold construction إذا جاء is answered later by a clause containing كان.
The event nouns are followed by imperatives and a stable divine description rather than a narrative stop.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a punctual arrival, an opening-beginning, continuance, temporal presence, and elicited return; I infer that the event is nested in an enduring return-process. Alternatively, كان may simply support a conventional divine predicate without contrasting temporal scales.

changed_reading.before: Victory arrives once and closes the prior story.
changed_reading.after: A punctual opening occurs inside enduring lordship and begins repeated reorientation; the event is real but not self-sufficient or terminal.

context_deltas.mechanism: The baseline water network acquires a social-ecological extension: rain and tributaries reach an opened channel, cohorts move through a broad gap like distributed flow, and the result is nurture and growth. The people are not equated with water; flow is the reader-supplied analogy linking the packet's material branches.

activation_trace.role: The water-gathering hollow supplies the catchment into which distant relief converges.
Relieving rain that causes growth supplies the life-giving input.
Tributaries bringing water from afar supply convergence and distribution.
Water released through an opening supplies controlled outflow from the achieved threshold.
Human groups supply the distributed social units carried by the analogy.
A broad gap supplies the channel widened for grouped passage.
Running or swimming supplies movement through a medium rather than static accumulation.
Rain-bearing cloud supplies an upstream ecological counterpart to the rain-relief branch.
The split image of nourishment and growth supplies the downstream effect of distributed flow.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from arrival and opening to grouped entry and then to an imperative whose root also carries free movement through water.
Plural cohorts prevent the material analogy from collapsing into one undifferentiated mass.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rain, tributaries, an opened watercourse, a broad gap, grouped movement, cloud, and growth; I infer a social-irrigation analogy connecting them. A live alternative is accidental branch resonance with no intended cross-domain mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The water branches offer a self-contained image of relief reaching an outlet.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the opening distributes divine relief into social growth: cohorts move through it as differentiated flows through a widened, life-giving channel.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant ر و ي mapping behind رأيت rather than the dominant sight branch. It remains anchored to the arrived event and to the packet's explicit split inventory, but downstream prose should call it a transmission afterimage, not translate رأيت as narration.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: An event that comes and opens can pass from occurrence into a carried account of that occurrence.

activation_trace.role: Arrival supplies the event that can subsequently become reportable.
Prevailing aid supplies the event-content carried into public memory.
The split-root image of transmitting news or poetry supplies a secondary movement from witnessed event to narrated event.

changed_reading.after: As a contained split-root afterimage, victory also becomes transmissible narrative: an arrival that can be carried beyond those who directly saw it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain medical analogy is surprising and branch-distant, but it is anchored by a focus branch for matter collected in a wound, the focus aperture, and a context branch for wound relapse. Downstream prose should present it only as an analogy of accumulated injury, release, and aftercare, never as a lexical paraphrase of the ayah.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: جاء and الفتح can jointly image accumulated matter reaching an opening, while later غفر carries the possibility of a wound's relapse.

activation_trace.role: Collected matter from a wound supplies the image of injury that has accumulated to a point of release.
Redress after oppression supplies the social injury for which release would count as relief.
Opening a closure supplies drainage or exposure of what had been trapped.
Relapse of illness or wound supplies the warning that opening and relief do not eliminate the need for aftercare.

changed_reading.before: Victory cleanly removes an external obstacle.
changed_reading.after: As a contained wound analogy, redress opens and releases accumulated injury, while the command that follows guards against relapse after the dramatic relief.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the non-dominant ت ب ب split under توابا, especially its cutting image. It remains anchored to الفتح as an opening beginning and to the packet's supplied split, but downstream prose should call it a cutover shadow of return, not import cutting into the direct meaning of تواب.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The opening can be a beginning precisely because a prior configuration is severed at the threshold.

activation_trace.role: Arrival supplies the threshold at which the transition takes effect.
An opening beginning supplies the new phase initiated at the threshold.
The split-root cutting image supplies a contained severance of the prior order that makes return a genuine reorientation.

changed_reading.before: Opening simply adds a victorious new condition.
changed_reading.after: As a contained split-root shadow, the opening is a cutover: it begins a new orientation by severing continuity with the configuration that preceded it.

strongest_changes: The arrival-and-opening threshold becomes publicly legible through grouped human entry rather than remaining an invisible transfer of power.
Conquest is revised into permeability: people cross into obedience, while visible entry and inward entrustment remain distinguishable.
The repeated divine name makes aid's source and the entered religion's destination form an anti-appropriation circuit.
The response in 110:3 turns opening from a terminal triumph into the start of praise, protection, nurture, and repeated return.
Juridical, inward, and hydraulic mechanisms remain live beside the prevailing-aid reading rather than being merged into it.
summary.what_was_special: The focus-only branch constellations already supported legal redress, gifted disclosure, and a coherent water network. Context then made opening social and porous, exposed an ego-risk in public success, and extended the water network into a carefully contained social-irrigation model. Non-dominant split roots were retained as explicit exploratory activators rather than silently collapsed.
remaining_uncertainties: The conjunction of aid and opening supports coupling but does not by itself prove that aid causally precedes opening.
The packet leaves outward group entry, inward assent, compelled compliance, and performative display simultaneously possible.
The civic, hydraulic, wound, narration, and cutover models depend on branch constellations or split mappings and should remain analogical rather than direct glosses.
The exact temporal force contributed by كان to the contrast between punctual arrival and enduring return remains open.
